tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm paper in light, near-black in dark. Text on it: ink (15.7:1).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs and inputs sitting on paper. Hairline border, no heavy shadow.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: image mats, progress tracks, code and ID blocks. Text on it: ink-muted (6.0:1 minimum).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the darkest identity block. Never for borders.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: artist and date, captions, help text. 6.0:1 or better on paper, card and sunken.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers. Not for the border of a control (too faint).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and unfilled stepper nodes. 3:1 or better on paper and card.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Verdigris. Primary actions, links, the active gate, focus. The one brand hue.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (7.9:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: selected card, active row. Accent on it: 6.6:1.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Verified and open. Always paired with a check icon and a text label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of verified and open badges.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs a human check, unverified, near the cap. Always with an alert icon and a label.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Permission required, blocked, cap reached, irreversible actions. Always with a lock or alert icon and a label.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of blocked badges and banners.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour. 2px, offset 2px. 3:1 or better on paper and card.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: The wordmark and the empty-state headline. One per screen at most.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles in sans. Artwork titles use the serif display face at body size instead.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badge text, field labels, gate type tags. Write in sentence case.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Object IDs, run IDs, config hashes, record field names and evidence chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text gap, badge inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls, chip gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Badge and input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between card sections, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large blocks, cover geometry.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, evidence chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, cost meter.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. Only floating layers get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards: a hairline of depth only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus only.
